signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ)
  (xs : n → ℝ) : (n → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr
doc:
Expected squared error `E‖x_k - xs‖²` after `k` randomized Kaczmarz steps started at `x`,
rows drawn i.i.d. with probabilities `prob A`. Defined by first-step recursion:
`expErr 0 x = ‖x - xs‖²`, `expErr (k+1) x = ∑ i, prob A i * expErr k (step A b x i)`.
See `expErr_eq_sum_paths` for the path-sum form. Atlas `randomized-kaczmarz`.
atlas: kaczmarz-def

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_eq_sum_paths.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
  (b : m → ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
  NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr A b xs x k =
    ∑ ω,
      (∏ j, NLAlib.Kaczmarz.prob A (ω j)) * (NLAlib.Kaczmarz.run A b k ω x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (NLAlib.Kaczmarz.run A b k ω x - xs)
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_eq_sum_paths
doc:
`expErr` is the expectation over i.i.d. row sequences: the sum over all `ω : Fin k → m` of
`(∏ j, prob A (ω j)) * ‖run A b k ω x - xs‖²`. Atlas `randomized-kaczmarz`.

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_le.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
  (b : m → ℝ) (xs : n → ℝ) (hxs : A.mulVec xs = b) (σ : ℝ)
  (hσ : ∀ (v : n → ℝ), σ ^ 2 * v ⬝ᵥ v ≤ A.mulVec v ⬝ᵥ A.mulVec v) (x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
  NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr A b xs x k ≤ (1 - σ ^ 2 / NLAlib.frobSq A) ^ k * (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_le
doc:
**Randomized Kaczmarz converges linearly in expectation.**
Strohmer–Vershynin 2009, Thm 2; atlas `randomized-kaczmarz`.
If `A *ᵥ xs = b` and `σ² ‖v‖² ≤ ‖A v‖²` for all `v`, then after `k` steps with rows drawn
i.i.d. with probability `‖A i‖² / ‖A‖_F²`,
`E‖x_k - xs‖² ≤ (1 - σ² / ‖A‖_F²)^k ‖x₀ - xs‖²`.
Deviations from the printed statement: SV09 take `A` of full column rank and `σ = ‖A⁻¹‖⁻¹`
(rate `1 - κ(A)⁻²`); here `σ` is any constant satisfying `hσ` (the sharp choice is
`σ_min(A)`, atlas `courant-fischer`), and no rank or nonzero-row assumption is needed.
atlas: randomized-kaczmarz

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_le_add.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
  (b : m → ℝ) (xh : n → ℝ) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : ∀ (v : n → ℝ), σ ^ 2 * v ⬝ᵥ v ≤ A.mulVec v ⬝ᵥ A.mulVec v) (x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
  NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr A b xh x k ≤
    (1 - σ ^ 2 / NLAlib.frobSq A) ^ k * (x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh) +
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, (1 - σ ^ 2 / NLAlib.frobSq A) ^ j) *
        ((b - A.mulVec xh) ⬝ᵥ (b - A.mulVec xh) / NLAlib.frobSq A)
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_le_add
doc:
**Randomized Kaczmarz on inconsistent systems.** If `σ²‖v‖² ≤ ‖Av‖²` for all `v`, then for
any reference point `xh` and `e = b − A xh`, with `ρ = 1 − σ²/‖A‖_F²`,
`E‖x_k − xh‖² ≤ ρ^k ‖x₀ − xh‖² + (∑_{j<k} ρ^j) ‖e‖²/‖A‖_F²`.
Source: Needell (2010) [`needell10`], Thm 2.1 (stated for norms, with `xh` the least-squares
solution); Zouzias–Freris (2013) [`zf13`], eq. (5) (squared form).
Atlas: `kaczmarz-inconsistent`; uses `randomized-kaczmarz`.
Deviation: any reference point `xh` (no least-squares or consistency assumption); the geometric
sum is kept exact.
atlas: kaczmarz-inconsistent

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_le_add_div_sq.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
  (b : m → ℝ) (xh : n → ℝ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ0 : 0 < σ) (hσ : ∀ (v : n → ℝ), σ ^ 2 * v ⬝ᵥ v ≤ A.mulVec v ⬝ᵥ A.mulVec v)

  NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr A b xh x k ≤
    (1 - σ ^ 2 / NLAlib.frobSq A) ^ k * (x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh) + (b - A.mulVec xh) ⬝ᵥ (b - A.mulVec xh) / σ ^ 2
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.expErr_le_add_div_sq
doc:
**Randomized Kaczmarz on inconsistent systems, horizon form.** If `σ > 0` and
`σ²‖v‖² ≤ ‖Av‖²` for all `v`, then for any `xh`,
`E‖x_k − xh‖² ≤ (1 − σ²/‖A‖_F²)^k ‖x₀ − xh‖² + ‖b − A xh‖²/σ²`.
Source: Needell (2010) [`needell10`], Thm 2.1 (squared form, `R = ‖A‖_F²/σ²`);
Zouzias–Freris (2013) [`zf13`], Thm 2. Atlas: `kaczmarz-inconsistent`.
atlas: kaczmarz-inconsistent

name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sqErr_step
doc:
Pythagoras for one Kaczmarz step (the step is an orthogonal projection onto a hyperplane
containing `xs`): `‖step A b x i - xs‖² = ‖x - xs‖² - (A i ⬝ᵥ (x - xs))² / ‖A i‖²`.
Holds for every row; for a zero row both sides equal `‖x - xs‖²`.
Strohmer–Vershynin 2009, proof of Thm 2; atlas `randomized-kaczmarz`.

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sqErr_step_eq_add.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ)
  (xh x : n → ℝ) (i : m) :
  (NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step A b x i - xh) ⬝ᵥ (NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step A b x i - xh) =
    (x - xh) ⬝ᵥ (x - xh) - (A i ⬝ᵥ (x - xh)) ^ 2 / A i ⬝ᵥ A i + (b i - A i ⬝ᵥ xh) ^ 2 / A i ⬝ᵥ A i
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sqErr_step_eq_add
doc:
One Kaczmarz step from an arbitrary reference point `xh` (no consistency assumed): with
`e = b − A xh`,
`‖step A b x i − xh‖² = ‖x − xh‖² − (Aᵢ ⬝ (x − xh))²/‖Aᵢ‖² + eᵢ²/‖Aᵢ‖²`.
Source: Needell (2010) [`needell10`], proof of Thm 2.1. Atlas: `kaczmarz-inconsistent`.

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (x : n → ℝ)
  (i : m) : n → ℝ
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step
doc:
One Kaczmarz step on row `i`: the orthogonal projection of `x` onto the hyperplane
`{y | A i ⬝ᵥ y = b i}`. For a zero row the step is the identity (real division by zero is `0`).
Strohmer–Vershynin 2009, Algorithm (eq. (2)); atlas `randomized-kaczmarz`.
atlas: kaczmarz-def

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step_sub_mem_range_of_sub_mem_range.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
  [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (xh x : n → ℝ) (hx : x - xh ∈ A.transpose.mulVecLin.range) (i : m) :
  NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step A b x i - xh ∈ A.transpose.mulVecLin.range
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step_sub_mem_range_of_sub_mem_range
doc:
An arbitrary affine Kaczmarz update preserves row-space error membership.
No consistency assumption on the right-hand side or reference point is needed.
Needell 2010, proof of Theorem 2.1; atlas `kaczmarz-inconsistent` (invariant helper).

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step_sub_solution.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ)
  (xs x : n → ℝ) (hxs : A.mulVec xs = b) (i : m) :
  NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step A b x i - xs = x - xs - (A i ⬝ᵥ (x - xs) / A i ⬝ᵥ A i) • A i
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.step_sub_solution
doc:
Error recursion of one Kaczmarz step when `A *ᵥ xs = b`:
`step A b x i - xs = (x - xs) - ((A i ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)) / ‖A i‖²) • A i`.
Strohmer–Vershynin 2009, proof of Thm 2; atlas `randomized-kaczmarz`.

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_paths_le.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
  (b : m → ℝ) (xs : n → ℝ) (hxs : A.mulVec xs = b) (σ : ℝ)
  (hσ : ∀ (v : n → ℝ), σ ^ 2 * v ⬝ᵥ v ≤ A.mulVec v ⬝ᵥ A.mulVec v) (x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
  ∑ ω,
      (∏ j, NLAlib.Kaczmarz.prob A (ω j)) *
        (NLAlib.Kaczmarz.run A b k ω x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (NLAlib.Kaczmarz.run A b k ω x - xs) ≤
    (1 - σ ^ 2 / NLAlib.frobSq A) ^ k * (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_paths_le
doc:
Path-sum form of SV09 Thm 2: the weighted average over all row sequences of length `k` of
the squared error is at most `(1 - σ² / ‖A‖_F²)^k ‖x - xs‖²`.
Strohmer–Vershynin 2009, Thm 2; atlas `randomized-kaczmarz`.

signature:
NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_prob.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ)
  (hA : A ≠ 0) : ∑ i, NLAlib.Kaczmarz.prob A i = 1
name: NLAlib.Kaczmarz.sum_prob
doc: The selection probabilities sum to one when `A ≠ 0`. Atlas `randomized-kaczmarz`.

signature: NLAlib.LUPartialPivotSucceeds {n : ℕ} : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → Prop
name: NLAlib.LUPartialPivotSucceeds
doc:
**Success of partial pivoting**: every pivot (after the row swap) is nonzero.
Golub–Van Loan 2013, §3.4.
atlas: lu-partial-pivoting

signature: NLAlib.LUSucceeds {n : ℕ} : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → Prop
name: NLAlib.LUSucceeds
doc:
**Success of Gaussian elimination**: every pivot (the `(1,1)` entry of `A` and of each
successive Schur complement) is nonzero. All `n` pivots are required, so success also gives an
invertible `U`; the realisation `A = LU` itself only uses the first `n − 1` (see
`exists_isLU_of_forall_det_ne_zero`). Trefethen–Bau 1997, Lect. 20; Golub–Van Loan 2013, §3.2.
atlas: lu-algorithm

signature: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) : Type u_1
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp
doc:
A **Lanczos decomposition**: an Arnoldi decomposition, used for symmetric `A` (then
`T = Qᵀ A Q` is a Jacobi matrix, `LanczosDecomp.T`). Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`],
Ch. 4.
atlas: lanczos-recurrence

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.Q_apply_diagonal_sqrt_eq_eval_poly_mul.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
  {t w : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp (Matrix.diagonal t) (fun i => √(w i)) q) (r : n) (j : Fin q) :
  D.Q r j = √(w r) * Polynomial.eval (t r) (D.poly ↑j)
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.Q_apply_diagonal_sqrt_eq_eval_poly_mul
doc:
For a diagonal spectral problem, each Lanczos column is the corresponding
polynomial evaluated at each node, multiplied by its square-root weight.
Source: Gautschi (2004), Section 2.2.3.2.
atlas: discrete-measure-jacobi-matrix (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
  (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℝ
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T
doc:
The Jacobi matrix `T_q = Q_qᵀ A Q_q` of a Lanczos decomposition (the Hessenberg matrix `H_q`
under its Lanczos name). Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Ch. 4.
atlas: lanczos-recurrence

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_apply_eq_zero_of_one_lt_dist
doc:
**For symmetric `A`, `T_q` is tridiagonal**: `t_ij = 0` whenever `|i − j| > 1`.
Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Thm 4.2; Trefethen–Bau (1997) [`tb97`], Lect. 36.
atlas: lanczos-recurrence, graded-krylov-basis-def (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_eq_jacobiMatrix.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ}
  {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) : D.T = NLAlib.jacobiMatrix D.alpha D.beta q
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_eq_jacobiMatrix
doc:
For symmetric `A`, `T_q` is the Jacobi matrix of its recurrence coefficients:
`T_q = jacobiMatrix α β q`. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Thm 4.2.
Atlas: `jacobi-matrix-identities`.
atlas: jacobi-matrix-identities (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_eq_ldl.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
  (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.PosDef) :
  D.T =
    (NLAlib.jacobiLDLLower D.alpha D.beta q * Matrix.diagonal fun i => NLAlib.jacobiLDLPivot D.alpha D.beta ↑i) *
      (NLAlib.jacobiLDLLower D.alpha D.beta q).transpose
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_eq_ldl
doc:
The actual symmetric SPD Lanczos Jacobi matrix equals its explicit
positive-pivot unit lower bidiagonal LDL transpose product.
atlas: kernel-polynomials-christoffel (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_mulVec_eval_poly_eq_smul.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
  {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) (i : Fin q) :
  (D.T.mulVec fun j => Polynomial.eval (⋯.eigenvalues i) (D.poly ↑j)) =
    ⋯.eigenvalues i • fun j => Polynomial.eval (⋯.eigenvalues i) (D.poly ↑j)
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_mulVec_eval_poly_eq_smul
doc:
The polynomial-evaluation vector at a Gauss node is an eigenvector of the
Jacobi matrix. It remains valid at finite-support termination, without a
degree-`q` normalized polynomial. Source: Gautschi (2004), Theorem 1.31.
atlas: gauss-christoffel-numbers (partial)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_restrict_eq_jacobiMatrix
doc:
The leading actual Lanczos compression has the parent's diagonal and
off-diagonal coefficients on its included indices.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.X_mul_poly.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
  (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ} (hj : j + 1 < q) :
  Polynomial.X * D.poly j =
    Polynomial.C (D.beta j) * D.poly (j - 1) + Polynomial.C (D.alpha j) * D.poly j +
      Polynomial.C (D.beta (j + 1)) * D.poly (j + 1)
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.X_mul_poly
doc:
**Three-term recurrence of the Lanczos polynomials**: for symmetric `A` and `j + 1 < q`,
`X p_j = β_j p_{j−1} + α_j p_j + β_{j+1} p_{j+1}`, so the Jacobi matrix `T` holds the recurrence
coefficients of the orthonormal polynomials of `μ_b`. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`],
Thm 2.1 and Thm 4.2.
atlas: lanczos-orthogonal-polynomials (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.abs_beta_le_specNorm.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
  {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (j : ℕ) : |D.beta j| ≤ NLAlib.specNorm A
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.abs_beta_le_specNorm
doc:
Every signed Lanczos off-diagonal has magnitude at most the ambient spectral
norm. It applies to arbitrary basis signs and to the zero boundary coefficients.
Source: Gautschi (2004), Theorem 1.28.
atlas: recurrence-coefficient-bounds (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.aeval_poly_T_mulVec_transpose_Q_eq_single.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
  {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (j : Fin q) :
  ((Polynomial.aeval D.T) (D.poly ↑j)).mulVec (D.Q.transpose.mulVec b) = Pi.single j 1
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.aeval_poly_T_mulVec_transpose_Q_eq_single
doc:
The compressed polynomial vector is the corresponding coordinate vector.
This holds for each actual Lanczos polynomial, without choosing its sign.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.alpha.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
  (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (j : ℕ) : ℝ
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.alpha
doc:
The Lanczos diagonal coefficient `α_j = t_jj = q_jᵀ A q_j` (`0` for `j ≥ q`).
Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Alg. 4.1. Atlas: `lanczos-recurrence`.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.alpha_mem_Icc_lambdaMin_lambdaMax.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
  {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < q) :
  D.alpha j ∈ Set.Icc (NLAlib.lambdaMin A) (NLAlib.lambdaMax A)
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.alpha_mem_Icc_lambdaMin_lambdaMax
doc:
Every Lanczos diagonal lies between the smallest and largest ambient
Hermitian eigenvalues. The existence of its column supplies nonempty dimension.
Source: Gautschi (2004), Theorem 1.28.
atlas: recurrence-coefficient-bounds (partial)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.alpha_mem_Icc_of_eigenvalues
doc:
Every Lanczos diagonal lies in every interval containing the ambient
Hermitian spectrum. Source: Gautschi (2004), Theorem 1.28.
atlas: recurrence-coefficient-bounds (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
  (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (j : ℕ) : ℝ
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta
doc:
The Lanczos off-diagonal coefficient `β_j = t_{j,j−1} = q_jᵀ A q_{j−1}` (`β_0 = 0`, and `0`
for `j ≥ q`). Indexing: `A q_j = β_j q_{j−1} + α_j q_j + β_{j+1} q_{j+1}` (0-based columns).
Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Alg. 4.1 (there `η_j`). Atlas: `lanczos-recurrence`.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta_arnoldiDecomp_pos.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
  (b : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (h : q ≤ NLAlib.krylovGrade A b) {j : ℕ} (h0 : 0 < j) (hj : j < q) :
  0 < NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta (NLAlib.arnoldiDecomp A b q h) j
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta_arnoldiDecomp_pos
doc:
The canonical (Gram–Schmidt) decomposition has positive `β_j` for `0 < j < q`.
Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Alg. 4.1 (`η_j = ‖v_j‖ > 0`).
Atlas: `lanczos-recurrence`.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta_ne_zero.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ}
  {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) {j : ℕ} (h0 : 0 < j) (hj : j < q) : D.beta j ≠ 0
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta_ne_zero
doc:
The Lanczos off-diagonal coefficients do not vanish below the grade: `β_j ≠ 0` for
`0 < j < q`. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Thm 4.2 (no breakdown before the grade).
Atlas: `lanczos-recurrence`.

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.cfc_T_apply_zero_zero
doc:
**Golub–Welsch**: `e₁ᵀ f(T_q) e₁ = ∑ᵢ f(θᵢ) (uᵢ)₁²` with `(θᵢ, uᵢ)` the eigenpairs of
`T_q`: the Gauss rule has the eigenvalues of `T_q` as nodes and the squared first components
of its eigenvectors as weights. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Ch. 6 (Golub–Welsch).
atlas: jacobi-matrix-identities (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_T_dilation_two_mul_add_one_eq_X_mul_comp_X_sq.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2}
  [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {B : Matrix m n ℝ} {u : m → ℝ} {k : ℕ}
  (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp (NLAlib.dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0) (2 * k + 1)) :
  D.T.charpoly =
    Polynomial.X *
      (NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial (NLAlib.polynomialIntegral (NLAlib.spectralMeasure ⋯ (B.transpose.mulVec u)) ⋯)
            k).comp
        (Polynomial.X ^ 2)
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_T_dilation_two_mul_add_one_eq_X_mul_comp_X_sq
doc:
At every valid odd order, the actual augmented Lanczos monic polynomial is `X`
times the right-normal spectral measure's canonical monic polynomial at `Bᵀu`,
composed with `X²`. Source: Gautschi (2004), Theorem 1.18 and Section 2.2; (OP19).
atlas: symmetric-measure-even-odd-reduction (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_T_dilation_two_mul_eq_comp_X_sq.{u_1, u_2} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [Fintype m]
  [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {B : Matrix m n ℝ} {u : m → ℝ} {k : ℕ}
  (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp (NLAlib.dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0) (2 * k)) :
  D.T.charpoly =
    (NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial (NLAlib.polynomialIntegral (NLAlib.spectralMeasure ⋯ u) ⋯) k).comp
      (Polynomial.X ^ 2)
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_T_dilation_two_mul_eq_comp_X_sq
doc:
At every valid even order, the actual augmented Lanczos monic polynomial is the
left-normal spectral measure's canonical monic polynomial composed with `X²`.
Source: Gautschi (2004), Theorem 1.18 and Section 2.2; operator derivations (OP19).
atlas: symmetric-measure-even-odd-reduction (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_T_monic.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ}
  {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) : D.T.charpoly.Monic ∧ D.T.charpoly.natDegree = q
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_T_monic
doc: `charpoly T_q` is monic of degree `q`. Atlas: `lanczos-orthogonal-polynomials`.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_restrict_T_mul_poly_zero.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
  {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < q) :
  (NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T (NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.restrict D ⋯)).charpoly * D.poly 0 =
    Polynomial.C (∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 j, D.beta k) * D.poly j
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_restrict_T_mul_poly_zero
doc:
**`det(x I − T_j)` is proportional to the Lanczos polynomial `p_j`**:
`χ_j p_0 = β_1 ⋯ β_j p_j` with `χ_j = charpoly T_j` (`p_0 = ±1/‖b‖` is a constant; for
`‖b‖ = 1` and the canonical signs this is `det(x I − T_j) = β_1 ⋯ β_j p_j(x)`).
Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Ch. 3 and Thm 4.2 (labels to verify).
atlas: lanczos-orthogonal-polynomials

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_restrict_T_succ_eq.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
  {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ} (hj : j + 1 ≤ q) :
  (NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T (NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.restrict D hj)).charpoly =
    (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (D.alpha j)) * (NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T (NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.restrict D ⋯)).charpoly -
      Polynomial.C (D.beta j ^ 2) * (NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T (NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.restrict D ⋯)).charpoly
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_restrict_T_succ_eq
doc:
Every actual leading monic characteristic polynomial satisfies the three-term
recurrence with the actual diagonal and squared signed off-diagonal. The final
displayed characteristic polynomial is included. Source: Gautschi (2004), Theorem 1.27; operator derivations (OF8).
atlas: monic-orthogonal-recurrence (partial)

NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.degree_poly.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.degree_poly_le.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ}
  {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (j : ℕ) : (D.poly j).degree ≤ ↑j

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq
doc:
**Gauss–Lanczos quadrature through the Jacobi matrix**: for symmetric `A`, `q ≥ 1` and
`deg p < 2q`, `bᵀ p(A) b = ‖b‖² (p(T_q))₁₁`. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Thm 6.6
and §7.1; Chen–Trogdon–Ubaru (2021) [`ctu21`], Thm 2.1. Deviation: the degree bound is
`p.degree < 2 * q` (no `natDegree`, no truncated subtraction).

`deg p < 2q`, `bᵀ p(A) b = ‖b‖² ∑ᵢ p(θᵢ) (uᵢ)₁²` with nodes `θᵢ` the eigenvalues of `T_q` and

Thm 6.6; Chen–Trogdon–Ubaru (2021) [`ctu21`], Thm 2.1.

`x` above the spectrum of `A`, `e₁ᵀ (x I − T_q)⁻¹ e₁ = 1/(x − α₀ − β₁²/(x − α₁ − ⋯ −

transform `∫ dμ_b(t)/(x − t)` (for `‖b‖ = 1`). Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Ch. 3
(continued fractions) and Thm 4.2. Deviation: real `x` above the spectrum
(so every trailing block is nonsingular); complex `x` off the real axis is not covered.

eq. (36.3).

    (NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.restrict D ⋯).Q * NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T (NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.restrict D ⋯) +

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_beta_smul
doc:
**The Lanczos relation** `A Q_q = Q_q T_q + β_q q_{q+1} e_qᵀ` (for `q ≥ 1`), with
`β_q = t_{q,q−1}` and `q_{q+1}` the last column of a decomposition of size `q + 1`; together with
`T_apply_eq_zero_of_one_lt_dist` (`T_q` symmetric tridiagonal for symmetric `A`) and
`ArnoldiDecomp.hasOrthonormalCols`, `ArnoldiDecomp.range_Q` this is the Lanczos
tridiagonalisation. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Thm 4.2; Chen–Trogdon–Ubaru (2021)
[`ctu21`], §2.
atlas: lanczos-recurrence

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.mul_sq_eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero_eq_inv_sum_sq_eval_poly.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n]
  [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.mul_sq_eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero_eq_inv_sum_sq_eval_poly
doc:
The Christoffel kernel has reciprocal equal to the mass-scaled first
eigenvector square. Source: Gautschi (2004), Corollary to Theorem 1.31.
atlas: gauss-christoffel-numbers (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.norm_sq_mul_cfc_T_le_quadForm_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n]

doc:
A nonnegative even derivative makes actual Lanczos Gauss quadrature a lower bound
for the matrix quadratic form. This includes zero error at Krylov termination.
Source: Gautschi (2004), corollary to Theorem 1.48; operator derivations after (AQ6).
atlas: gauss-quadrature-derivative-remainder (partial)

NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_spectralMeasure_eq_alpha.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]

doc:
The monic spectral-measure recurrence alpha is the actual Lanczos diagonal.
All stored indices are allowed, including the last diagonal. Source: Gautschi (2004), Theorem 1.27; operator derivations (OF8).
atlas: monic-orthogonal-recurrence (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_spectralMeasure_eq_beta_sq.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n]
  [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ}
  (hj : j < q) :
  NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (NLAlib.polynomialIntegral (NLAlib.spectralMeasure hA b) ⋯) j = D.beta j ^ 2

doc:
The monic spectral-measure beta equals the square of the stored signed
Lanczos off-diagonal. Order zero is the shared zero boundary coefficient; no
coupling beyond the decomposition is inferred. Source: Gautschi (2004), Theorem 1.27; operator derivations (OF8).
atlas: monic-orthogonal-recurrence (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_spectralMeasure_eq_beta_sq_of_eq_grade.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n]
  [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_spectralMeasure_eq_beta_sq_of_eq_grade
doc:
At exact grade the final monic beta is the squared zero terminal Lanczos
coupling. It is the zero norm ratio, and does not create a normalized final vector.
The zero-grade boundary is included. Source: terminal convention following (OF11).
atlas: monic-orthogonal-recurrence (partial)

signature:

The **Lanczos polynomial** `p_j` (indexed by `ℕ`, `0` for `j ≥ q`): the polynomial of degree

Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], §4.1 and Ch. 2. Atlas: `lanczos-orthogonal-polynomials`.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.posDef_T.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}

Positive definiteness passes to the actual Lanczos compression, including
the empty compression, by injectivity of its orthonormal columns.

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.posDef_smul_one_sub_T
doc: For `x` above the spectrum of `A`, `x I − T_q` is positive definite.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.quadForm_le_norm_sq_mul_cfc_T_of_iteratedDeriv_nonpos.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n]

A nonpositive even derivative makes actual Lanczos Gauss quadrature an upper bound
for the matrix quadratic form. Source: Gautschi (2004), corollary to Theorem 1.48.
atlas: gauss-quadrature-derivative-remainder (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.rule_eq_up_to_permutation_of_moments.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
  {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q)

doc:
Every distinct-node rule matching the first `2q` actual matrix moments is
the Lanczos Gauss rule, up to permutation. This includes exact grade termination.
Source: Gautschi (2004), Gauss-rule characterization; operator derivations AQ2.
atlas: quadrature-exactness-characterisation (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sq_eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero_pos.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
  {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sq_eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero_pos
doc:
Every normalized Gauss weight is strictly positive. Source: Gautschi (2004),
Theorem 1.46.
atlas: orthogonal-polynomial-zeros (partial), jacobi-matrix-identities (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sub_mul_sum_eval_poly_mul.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
  {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {m : ℕ} (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : m < q)

  (x - y) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, Polynomial.eval x (D.poly j) * Polynomial.eval y (D.poly j) =
    D.beta m *
      (Polynomial.eval x (D.poly m) * Polynomial.eval y (D.poly (m - 1)) -
        Polynomial.eval x (D.poly (m - 1)) * Polynomial.eval y (D.poly m))
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sub_mul_sum_eval_poly_mul
doc:
**Christoffel–Darboux identity** for the Lanczos polynomials: for symmetric `A` and
`1 ≤ m < q`, `(x − y) ∑_{j<m} p_j(x) p_j(y) = β_m (p_m(x) p_{m−1}(y) − p_{m−1}(x) p_m(y))`.
Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`], Ch. 2 (Christoffel–Darboux formula).
atlas: jacobi-matrix-identities (partial)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sum_eval_poly_mul_eval_poly_eq_div_weight
doc:
At full dimension the polynomial evaluations obey dual orthogonality at the
atomic nodes. Source: Gautschi (2004), Section 2.2.3.2. Positivity is needed only
to divide by the atomic weights.
atlas: discrete-measure-jacobi-matrix (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]

  ∑ i, (⋯.eigenvectorBasis i).ofLp ⟨0, hq⟩ ^ 2 = 1
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero
doc:
The Gauss weights sum to one: `∑ᵢ (uᵢ)₁² = 1`. Source: Golub–Meurant (2010) [`gm10`],
Thm 6.6. Atlas: `jacobi-matrix-identities`.

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sum_sq_eval_poly_eq_confluent_and_pos.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
  {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {m : ℕ} (hm0 : 0 < m)

  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, Polynomial.eval x (D.poly j) ^ 2 =
      D.beta m *
        (Polynomial.eval x (Polynomial.derivative (D.poly m)) * Polynomial.eval x (D.poly (m - 1)) -
          Polynomial.eval x (Polynomial.derivative (D.poly (m - 1))) * Polynomial.eval x (D.poly m)) ∧
    0 < ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, Polynomial.eval x (D.poly j) ^ 2
name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sum_sq_eval_poly_eq_confluent_and_pos
doc:
The actual signed Lanczos polynomials have a strictly positive confluent
Christoffel–Darboux kernel in every normalized positive-order range. At the terminal
order use the monic norm-divided formula instead of a nonexistent normalized polynomial.
Source: Gautschi (2004), Corollary to Theorem 1.32; operator derivations (OF11).
atlas: monic-orthogonal-recurrence (partial), jacobi-matrix-identities (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sum_weight_mul_eval_poly_mul_eval_poly.{u_1} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]

doc:
The first `q` actual Lanczos polynomials are orthonormal for the Gauss rule,
with weights for the original spectral measure rather than a probability
normalization. Source: Gautschi (2004), Theorem 1.22.
atlas: gauss-christoffel-numbers (partial)

signature: NLAlib.Majorized.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] (x y : ι → ℝ) : Prop
name: NLAlib.Majorized
doc:
Ordinary majorization is weak majorization together with equality of the
full coordinate totals. Marshall–Olkin–Arnold, Definition 1.A.1.
atlas: majorization-def

signature:
NLAlib.Majorized.exists_perm_sum_mul_le.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] {x y : ι → ℝ} (hxy : NLAlib.Majorized x y)

doc:
For any real weights, a majorized vector has a pairing bounded by a
permutation of the comparator. This is the exact support bound used in HLP.
Marshall–Olkin–Arnold (2011), Theorem 2.B.2.

name: NLAlib.Majorized.mem_convexHull_permutations
doc:
A majorized vector belongs to the convex hull of the comparator's
permutations. The proof separates the compact convex hull and contradicts the
signed support bound. Marshall–Olkin–Arnold (2011), Theorem 2.B.2.
atlas: majorization-def (partial)

signature: NLAlib.Majorized.refl.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] (x : ι → ℝ) : NLAlib.Majorized x x
name: NLAlib.Majorized.refl
doc: Ordinary majorization is reflexive.

signature:
NLAlib.Majorized.sum_convex_le.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {x y : ι → ℝ}

Majorization implies the sum inequality for every real convex function.
Marshall–Olkin–Arnold (2011), Propositions 4.B.1–4.B.2.
atlas: majorization-def (partial)

signature:
NLAlib.Majorized.sum_sortedVector_mul_le.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] {x y : ι → ℝ} (hxy : NLAlib.Majorized x y)

name: NLAlib.Majorized.sum_sortedVector_mul_le
doc:
Majorization bounds every sorted-weight support functional.
Marshall–Olkin–Arnold (2011), the linear support criterion for HLP.

signature:
NLAlib.Majorized.sum_sub_sumLargest_le_sum.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {x y : ι → ℝ}

Ordinary majorization gives the corresponding bottom-subset bound by
applying the top-subset criterion to the complementary coordinates.
This signed form includes empty and full subsets.

signature: NLAlib.OperatorConvexOn (I : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop
name: NLAlib.OperatorConvexOn
doc:
`f` is **operator convex** on the convex set `I`: `f (t A + (1−t) H) ≼ t f(A) + (1−t) f(H)`
for all Hermitian complex matrices `A`, `H` of every size with spectra in `I`. "Every size" is
encoded as `∀ d : ℕ, … Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ` (universe-safe; `Fintype` index types reduce to
it by reindexing, `OperatorConvexOn.cfc_conjTranspose_mul_mul_le`); the size `d = 0` holds
trivially. The definition is over `ℂ`; the real case follows by complexification. Tropp 2015,
Def. 8.4.6.

NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} {s : Type u_3} {J : Type u_4} [Fintype m]
  [Fintype n] [Fintype s] [Fintype J] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (p : J → ℝ) (S : J → Matrix m s ℝ) (xs : n → ℝ) :
  (n → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ
name: NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr
doc:
The finite weighted squared-error recurrence. With normalized nonnegative weights,
`integral_sqErr_pathLaw` identifies it with the expectation after `k` iid sketch steps:
`expErr 0 x = ‖x − xs‖²`, `expErr (k+1) x = ∑ⱼ pⱼ expErr k (step A b (S j) x)`.
Atlas: `sketch-and-project`.
atlas: sketch-and-project

signature:
NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr_eq_sum_paths.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} {s : Type u_3}
  {J : Type u_4} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype s] [Fintype J] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (p : J → ℝ)
  (S : J → Matrix m s ℝ) (xs x : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
  NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr A b p S xs x k =
    ∑ ω, (∏ j, p (ω j)) * (NLAlib.SketchProject.run A b S k ω x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (NLAlib.SketchProject.run A b S k ω x - xs)
name: NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr_eq_sum_paths
doc: The error recurrence computes the finite path-weighted squared errors.

name: NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr_le
doc:
**Sketch-and-project converges linearly in expectation.** Let `A xs = b`, `pⱼ ≥ 0`,
`∑ pⱼ = 1`, and `λ ‖v‖² ≤ vᵀ W v` for all `v`, with `W = ∑ⱼ pⱼ (SⱼᵀA)⁺(SⱼᵀA)`. Then after `k`
steps with i.i.d. sketches, `E‖x_k − xs‖² ≤ (1 − λ)^k ‖x₀ − xs‖²`.
Source: Gower–Richtárik (2015) [`gr15`], Thm 4.6 (`B = I`; the sharp `λ` is
`λ_min⁺(W)`). Atlas: `sketch-and-project`; uses `pseudoinverse`. Deviation: finite sketch
distribution; expectation modelled by first-step recursion.
Atlas: `sketch-and-project` (finite recurrence bound).

signature:
NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr_le_of_sub_mem_range.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} {s : Type u_3}
  {J : Type u_4} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype s] [Fintype J] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (p : J → ℝ)
  (hp : ∀ (j : J), 0 ≤ p j) (hp1 : ∑ j, p j = 1) (S : J → Matrix m s ℝ) {xs : n → ℝ} (hxs : A.mulVec xs = b) {lam : ℝ}
  (hlam :
    ∀ v ∈ A.transpose.mulVecLin.range, lam * v ⬝ᵥ v ≤ v ⬝ᵥ (NLAlib.SketchProject.expectedProjector A p S).mulVec v)
  (x : n → ℝ) (hx : x - xs ∈ A.transpose.mulVecLin.range) (k : ℕ) :
  NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr A b p S xs x k ≤ (1 - lam) ^ k * (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)
name: NLAlib.SketchProject.expErr_le_of_sub_mem_range
doc:
**Sketch-and-project contraction on the row space.** For a consistent system,
an initial error in `range Aᵀ`, and a lower bound `λ‖v‖² ≤ vᵀ W v` only on that
row space, the finite iid sketch distribution satisfies
`E‖x_k-xs‖² ≤ (1-λ)^k ‖x₀-xs‖²`. No full-column-rank assumption is required.
Gower–Richtárik 2015, Theorem 4.6, Euclidean case `B = I`;
atlas `sketch-and-project`. Deviation: a finite sketch distribution, with expectation
given by the exact first-step recursion. The initial-error membership is essential.
Atlas: `sketch-and-project` (finite recurrence bound).

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_marked_reindex {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) :
  ∑ z,
      NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.contract F z.right x
          (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair z.pattern (z.row, z.left) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one
            (z.row, z.right) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero) ^
        2 =
    ∑ z, NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.contract F z.right x z.pattern ^ 2
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_marked_reindex
doc:
Exact coefficient-square reindexing for the transpose light hop.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.DirectionalConcrete`,

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_marked_synthesis_energy_le {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) :
  ∑ p,
      ∑ r,
        ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
          NLAlib.SparseSketch.euclideanNormSq (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked F x p r c) ≤
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.markedEnergy NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero F x
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_marked_synthesis_energy_le
doc:
Heavy correction synthesis energy is bounded by the finite marked-pair contraction energy.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.DirectionalConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_mulVec_coeff {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (k : Fin d) (σ : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  Matrix.mulVec (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime m F.rows) x (k, σ) =
    ∑ r,
      ∑ a ∈ σ.freshInRow r,
        ∑ c ∈ σ.lightInRow r,
          ∑ l,
            (F.u a).ofLp k * (F.u c).ofLp l *
              x
                (l,
                  NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair σ (r, a) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one (r, c)
                    NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_mulVec_coeff
doc:
Exact coefficient formula for the transpose light hop `H'`.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.DirectionalConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_mulVec_marked {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (k : Fin d) (σ : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  Matrix.mulVec (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime m F.rows) x (k, σ) =
    ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ σ.lightInRow r, (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked F x σ r c).ofLp k
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_mulVec_marked
doc:
Paper equation `(Hprime-coeff)` on the actual finite pattern basis.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.DirectionalConcrete`,

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_output_coeff_energy_eq {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) :
  ∑ p,
      ∑ r,
        ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
          ∑ a ∈ p.freshInRow r,
            NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.contract F c x
                (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair p (r, a) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one (r, c)
                  NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero) ^
              2 =
    ∑ z,
      NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.contract F z.right x
          (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair z.pattern (z.row, z.left) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one
            (z.row, z.right) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero) ^
        2

The corresponding exact marked-output identity for the transpose hop.

  NLAlib.SparseSketch.sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime m F.rows) x) ≤

signature:

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.directional_energy_half_sq_bound

NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) (r : Fin m) (c : Fin n) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.EVec d
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked
doc:
The marked output vector `z'_{σ,r,c}`.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.DirectionalConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked_apply {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) (r : Fin m) (c : Fin n)
  (k : Fin d) :
  (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked F x σ r c).ofLp k =
    ∑ a ∈ σ.freshInRow r,
      (F.u a).ofLp k *
        NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.contract F c x
          (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair σ (r, a) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one (r, c)
            NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked_apply
doc:
The marked heavy correction coefficient evaluates its transitioned input fiber.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.DirectionalConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked_normSq_le {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) (r : Fin m) (c : Fin n) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.euclideanNormSq (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked F x σ r c) ≤
    ∑ a ∈ σ.freshInRow r,
      NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.contract F c x
          (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair σ (r, a) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one (r, c)
            NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero) ^
        2
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprimeMarked_normSq_le
doc:
The marked heavy correction energy is bounded by its input contraction energy.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.DirectionalConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprime_wordKernel_apply {m n : ℕ} {r : Fin m} {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j)
  (out inp : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pDown, NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pUp) out inp =
    if
        out (r, i) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero ∧
          out (r, j) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one ∧
            inp =
              NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair out (r, i) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one (r, j)
                NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero then
      1
    else 0
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.hprime_wordKernel_apply

The heavy correction word kernel has exactly the prescribed pair-transition coefficient.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.markedEnergy_eq_nested {d m n : ℕ} (a b : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level)

signature:

  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) (k : Fin d)
  (σ : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  Matrix.mulVec
      (NLAlib.SparseSketch.orderedWordTerm u r i j (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pDown, NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pUp)) x
      (k, σ) =
    if σ (r, i) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero ∧ σ (r, j) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one then
      ∑ l,
        u i k * u j l *
          x
            (l,
              NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair σ (r, i) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one (r, j)
                NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero)
    else 0

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.yPlusMarked
doc:
The marked output vector `z⁺_{σ,r,c}`.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.DirectionalConcrete`,

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.yPlusMarked_apply {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) (r : Fin m) (c : Fin n)
  (k : Fin d) :
  (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.yPlusMarked F x σ r c).ofLp k =
    ∑ a ∈ σ.heavyInRow r,
      (F.u a).ofLp k *
        NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.contract F c x
          (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair σ (r, a) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one (r, c)
            NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.yPlusMarked_apply
doc:
The marked mixed raising coefficient evaluates its transitioned input fiber.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.DirectionalConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.yPlusMarked_normSq_le {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) (r : Fin m) (c : Fin n) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.euclideanNormSq (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.yPlusMarked F x σ r c) ≤
    ∑ a ∈ σ.heavyInRow r,

          (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair σ (r, a) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one (r, c)
            NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero) ^
        2

doc:

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.yPlus_wordKernel_apply {m n : ℕ} {r : Fin m} {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j)
  (out inp : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.rUp, NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pUp) out inp =
    if
        out (r, i) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.two ∧
          out (r, j) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one ∧
            inp =
              NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair out (r, i) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one (r, j)
                NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero then
      1
    else 0
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.yPlus_wordKernel_apply
doc:
The mixed directional raising word kernel has exactly the prescribed pair-transition coefficient.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.DirectionalConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

        ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,

            (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.rUp, NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.rDown) +

  (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownMatrix F r).mulVec x σ =
    ∑ i ∈ σ.lightInRow r,
      NLAlib.SparseSketch.analyze F
        (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.fiber x
          (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.setSite σ (r, i) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.two))
        i

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.one_rDown_analysis {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) (σ : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  ∑ inp, (F.u i).ofLp inp.1 * NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rDownAt r i σ inp.2 * x inp =
    if σ (r, i) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one then
      NLAlib.SparseSketch.analyze F
        (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.fiber x
          (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.setSite σ (r, i) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.two))
        i
    else 0
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.one_rDown_analysis
doc:
Analyzing one heavy annihilation leg gives the frame coefficient of the transitioned external fiber.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.HeavyBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.one_rUp_analysis {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) (σ : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  ∑ inp, (F.u i).ofLp inp.1 * NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rUpAt r i σ inp.2 * x inp =
    if σ (r, i) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.two then
      NLAlib.SparseSketch.analyze F
        (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.fiber x
          (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.setSite σ (r, i) NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one))
        i
    else 0

doc:
Analyzing one heavy creation leg gives the frame coefficient of the transitioned external fiber.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_DDown {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) :
  NLAlib.quadForm (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.DDown F) x =
    ∑ r, ∑ i, NLAlib.SparseSketch.sumSq ((NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownOne F r i).mulVec x)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_DDown
doc:
The annihilation diagonal quadratic form is the sum of same-site annihilation-analysis energies.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.HeavyBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_DUp {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) :
  NLAlib.quadForm (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.DUp F) x =
    ∑ r, ∑ i, NLAlib.SparseSketch.sumSq ((NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUpOne F r i).mulVec x)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_DUp
doc:
The creation diagonal quadratic form is the sum of same-site creation-analysis energies.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.HeavyBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_Hzero {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) :
  NLAlib.quadForm (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Hzero m F.rows) x =
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.sumSq ((NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUpStack F).mulVec x) +
        NLAlib.SparseSketch.sumSq ((NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownStack F).mulVec x) -
      (NLAlib.quadForm (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.DUp F) x + NLAlib.quadForm (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.DDown F) x)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_Hzero
doc:
The preserving heavy quadratic form is its two analysis energies minus the diagonal corrections.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.HeavyBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_gradeConj {d m n : ℕ} (M : NLAlib.SparseSketch.FullOp d m n) (nu : ℕ)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) :
  NLAlib.quadForm (NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu * M * NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu) x =
    NLAlib.quadForm M (Matrix.mulVec (NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu) x)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_gradeConj
doc:
Conjugating by the grade projection evaluates the quadratic form on the projected vector.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.HeavyBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_gram.{u_1, u_2} {I : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
  [DecidableEq I] (A : Matrix I J ℝ) (x : J → ℝ) :
  NLAlib.quadForm (A.transpose * A) x = NLAlib.SparseSketch.sumSq (A.mulVec x)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_gram
doc:
A real Gram quadratic form equals the squared coordinate energy of its matrix action.

  (s : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Site m n) {a b : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level} (hs : p s = a) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.setSite (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.setSite p s b) s a = p
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.setSite_restore
doc:
Restoring the original level undoes a marked-site replacement.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.HeavyBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.siteKernel_ketBra_apply {m n : ℕ} (s : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Site m n)
  (outLevel inpLevel : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level) (out inp : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.siteKernel s (NLAlib.SparseSketch.ketBra outLevel inpLevel) out inp =
    if out s = outLevel ∧ inp = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.setSite out s inpLevel then 1 else 0
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.siteKernel_ketBra_apply
doc:
Exact coefficient of a lifted one-site rank-one transition.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.HeavyBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sqrt_mul_sqrt_add_two_le (nu : ℕ) : √(↑nu + 2) * √↑nu ≤ ↑nu + 1
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sqrt_mul_sqrt_add_two_le
doc:
The square-root product of grades separated by two is bounded by the intervening grade.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.HeavyBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.subset_analysis_le_card_mul {d n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (S : Finset (Fin n))
  (v : NLAlib.SparseSketch.EVec d) :
  ∑ i ∈ S, NLAlib.SparseSketch.analyze F v i ^ 2 ≤ ↑S.card * NLAlib.SparseSketch.euclideanNormSq v
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.subset_analysis_le_card_mul
doc:
Frame analysis restricted to a finite subset has energy bounded by its cardinality times input energy.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.HeavyBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sum_markedSite {m n : ℕ} (a : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level)
  (f : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) :
  ∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ i with p (r, i) = a, f p r i = ∑ z, f z.pattern z.row z.col
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sum_markedSite
doc:
Expand a sum over a marked-state subtype into its literal pattern/row/site
sum.  This is the bookkeeping bridge used by both marked reindexings.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.HeavyBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sum_markedTransition {m n : ℕ} (a b : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level)
  (f : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.MarkedSite m n b → ℝ) :
  ∑ z, f ((NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.markedTransition a b) z) = ∑ z, f z
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sum_markedTransition
doc:
A marked-site sum may be reindexed without multiplicity loss.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.HeavyBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sum_marked_reindex {m n : ℕ} (a b : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level)
  (f : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.MarkedSite m n a → ℝ) :
  ∑ z, f z = ∑ z, f ((NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.markedTransition a b).symm z)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sum_marked_reindex
doc:
The marked-level transition reindexes a finite marked-site sum exactly.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.HeavyBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sum_rowGrade {m n : ℕ} (p : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  ∑ r, NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rowGrade p r = p.grade
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sum_rowGrade
doc:
Summing the row occupation grades gives the total pattern grade.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.weighted_gradeProjection {d m n : ℕ} (nu : ℕ)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) :
  ∑ p,
      ↑p.grade *
        NLAlib.SparseSketch.euclideanNormSq
          (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.fiber (Matrix.mulVec (NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu) x) p) =
    ↑nu * NLAlib.SparseSketch.sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu) x)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.weighted_gradeProjection
doc:
On an exact grade, occupation-weighted energy is the grade times the projected energy.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.HeavyBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix
doc:

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightSectorConcrete`,

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_eq_sum_COne {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :

doc:
The row light creation synthesis matrix is the sum of its one-site summands.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_grade_relation
doc:
The row-local creation synthesis is grade `+1`.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_mul_cMatrix {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix F r * NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.cMatrix F r =
    ∑ i,
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        NLAlib.SparseSketch.orderedWordTerm F.rows r i j (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pUp, NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pUp)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_mul_cMatrix
doc:
Exact row-local factorization: the diagonal terms vanish by `P†²=0`.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_mul_transpose_decomposition {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (r : Fin m) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix F r * (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix F r).transpose =
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1Row F r +
      ∑ i,
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          NLAlib.SparseSketch.orderedWordTerm F.rows r i j (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pUp, NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pDown)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_mul_transpose_decomposition
doc:
A light synthesis co-Gram matrix splits into hopping and same-site diagonal corrections.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_transpose_apply {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
  (p : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) (out : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix F r).transpose p out =
    ∑ i, (F.u i).ofLp out.1 * NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pAt r i p out.2
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_transpose_apply
doc:
The transposed creation matrix has the corresponding annihilation entry formula.
Source: ported sparse-Fock shared-leg/vacuum proof, commit
`b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b`; supports `sparse-ose`.

  Matrix (Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) ℝ

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.COne_mul_COne_transpose_of_ne {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
  {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.COne F r i * (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.COne F r j).transpose =

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.COne_mul_cOne_of_ne {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n}
  (hij : i ≠ j) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.COne F r i * NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.cOne F r j =
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.orderedWordTerm F.rows r i j (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pUp, NLAlib.SparseSketch.Leg.pUp)

doc:

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CStack_mul_transpose
doc:
The stacked synthesis cogram is exactly the concrete shared-leg operator.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CStack_restricted_cogram
doc:
Exact cogram of the projected synthesis factor.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CStack_restricted_norm {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (mu : ℕ) :
  ‖NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection (mu + 1) * NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CStack F *
        NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rowGradeProjection mu‖ ≤
    √(↑d + ↑mu)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CStack_restricted_norm
doc:
Sharp restricted synthesis-stack bound.  The output projection is one
grade above the row input projection, exactly as required by the light and
mixed factorizations.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CStack_transpose_apply {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (out : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.RowFock m n) (inp : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CStack F).transpose out inp =
    (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix F out.1).transpose out.2 inp
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CStack_transpose_apply
doc:
The transposed light synthesis stack evaluates the corresponding row matrix coefficient.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) :
  Matrix (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.RowFock m n) (Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) ℝ
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack
doc:
Row-stacked creation analysis.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack_gradeProjection_norm {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (nu : ℕ) : ‖NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack F * NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu‖ ≤ √(↑m + ↑nu)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack_gradeProjection_norm
doc:
The analysis Gram bound `m+ν`, obtained from the fresh diagonal and the
concrete directional estimate for `H'`.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack_restricted_gram {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
  (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack F * NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu).transpose *
      (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack F * NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu) =
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu *
        (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0 F + NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime m F.rows) *
      NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack_restricted_gram
doc:
The light creation stack's restricted Gram matrix splits into the projected diagonal and light-band terms.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack_transpose_mul_self {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) :
  (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack F).transpose * NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack F =
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0 F + NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime m F.rows
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack_transpose_mul_self
doc:
The full creation-analysis Gram is the fresh diagonal plus the exact
light transpose hop `H'`.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.Ctranspose_mulVec_eq_zero_of_zeroLight {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)

signature: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0 {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) : NLAlib.SparseSketch.FullOp d m n
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0
doc:
The global fresh-site diagonal Gram term.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0Row {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.FullOp d m n
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0Row
doc:
The same-site, fresh-site diagonal part of one analysis Gram.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0Row_apply {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
  (out inp : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0Row F r out inp =
    if out.2 = inp.2 then NLAlib.SparseSketch.partialFrameOperator F (out.2.freshInRow r) out.1 inp.1 else 0
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0Row_apply
doc:
Entrywise form of the fresh-site diagonal Gram: on each Fock pattern it
is precisely the partial frame operator over the currently fresh columns.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0Row_fullFiber {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (p : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.fiber (Matrix.mulVec (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0Row F r) x) p =
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.applyMatrix (NLAlib.SparseSketch.partialFrameOperator F (p.freshInRow r))
      (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.fiber x p)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0Row_fullFiber
doc:
The row fresh-site diagonal correction acts through its selected frame-fiber contributions.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0Row_norm_le_one {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
  ‖NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0Row F r‖ ≤ 1
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0Row_norm_le_one
doc:
One row's fresh-site diagonal is a Euclidean contraction.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0_norm_le {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) :
  ‖NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0 F‖ ≤ ↑m
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0_norm_le
doc:
Summing the row contractions gives the exact paper bound `D₀ ≼ m I`.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1 {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) : NLAlib.SparseSketch.FullOp d m n
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1
doc:
Global same-site light-occupancy diagonal.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1Row {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.FullOp d m n
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1Row
doc:
Same-site part of the shared-leg cogram.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1Row_apply {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
  (out inp : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1Row F r out inp =
    if out.2 = inp.2 then NLAlib.SparseSketch.partialFrameOperator F (out.2.lightInRow r) out.1 inp.1 else 0
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1Row_apply
doc:
The occupied-site row diagonal correction is supported on identical patterns with light marked sites.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_apply {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (out inp : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1 F out inp =
    if out.2 = inp.2 then ∑ r, NLAlib.SparseSketch.partialFrameOperator F (out.2.lightInRow r) out.1 inp.1 else 0
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_apply
doc:
The total occupied-site diagonal correction sums the row corrections.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_fullFiber_rows {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (p : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.fiber (Matrix.mulVec (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1 F) x) p =
    ∑ r,
      NLAlib.SparseSketch.applyMatrix (NLAlib.SparseSketch.partialFrameOperator F (p.lightInRow r))
        (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.fiber x p)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_fullFiber_rows
doc:
The occupied-site diagonal correction acts on each fiber as a sum over rows.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_fullFiber_sites {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (p : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.fiber (Matrix.mulVec (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1 F) x) p =
    ∑ s ∈ p.light, NLAlib.SparseSketch.analyze F (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.fiber x p) s.2 • F.u s.2
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_fullFiber_sites
doc:
The occupied-site diagonal correction acts on each fiber as a sum over occupied sites.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_gradeProjection_norm {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
  ‖NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1 F * NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu‖ ≤ ↑nu
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_gradeProjection_norm
doc:
The light-occupancy diagonal has restricted norm at most the input grade.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_output_fiber_energy_le {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) (p : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.euclideanNormSq
      (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.fiber (Matrix.mulVec (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1 F) x) p) ≤
    ↑p.light.card ^ 2 * NLAlib.SparseSketch.euclideanNormSq (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.fiber x p)
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_output_fiber_energy_le
doc:
Occupied-site diagonal output-fiber energy is controlled by the light occupation count.
Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_restricted_energy {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (nu : ℕ)
  (x : Fin d × NLAlib.SparseSketch.Pattern m n → ℝ) :
  NLAlib.SparseSketch.sumSq ((NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1 F * NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu).mulVec x) ≤
    ↑nu ^ 2 * NLAlib.SparseSketch.sumSq x
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_restricted_energy
doc:
The occupied-site diagonal correction obeys the stated energy bound after grade projection.

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_supported_energy_le
doc:

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockGram_of_pairwise_certificate {ell : ℕ} (hell : 1 ≤ ell) {d quadratic : ℝ}
  (energy diagonal : Fin ell → ℝ) (cross : Fin ell → Fin ell → ℝ)
  (hquadratic : quadratic ≤ ∑ i, diagonal i + ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, cross i j)
  (hdiag : ∀ (i : Fin ell), diagonal i ≤ d * energy i)
  (hcross : ∀ (i j : Fin ell), i ≠ j → cross i j ≤ (energy i + energy j) / 2) :
  quadratic ≤ (d + ↑ell - 1) * ∑ i, energy i
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockGram_of_pairwise_certificate
doc:
A precise scalar certificate for the shared-leg block-Gram step.

To instantiate this with operators `V_i`, take `energy i = ‖z_i‖²`,
`diagonal i = ⟪z_i, V_i† V_i z_i⟫`, and let `cross i j` be the ordered
off-diagonal quadratic-form contribution.  The three hypotheses below are
exactly the facts that still have to be supplied by an operator formalization:

* `hquadratic`: expansion of the quadratic form into its blocks;
* `hdiag`: `V_i† V_i ≼ d I`;
* `hcross`: the cross-map contraction `‖V_i† V_j‖ ≤ 1` followed by scalar
  Cauchy--Schwarz.

The conclusion is the `d + ell - 1` light-sector constant.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightSectorAbstract`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.exists_permutation_of_legal_move {m n : ℕ} (T : Finset (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Site m n))
  (ell : ℕ) (out inp : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.BlockPattern T ell) (k : Fin ell) (r : Fin m) (i j : Fin n)
  (htarget : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.canonicalLightWord T ell out k = (r, i))
  (hsource : ↑inp (r, j) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one)
  (_havailable : (r, i) = (r, j) ∨ ↑inp (r, i) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero)
  (hmove : ↑out = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.lightMove ↑inp (r, j) (r, i)) :
  ∃ tau,
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.domainOfWord k (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.canonicalLightWord T ell out) =
        NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.domainOfWord k (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord T ell inp tau) ∧
      NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord T ell inp tau k = (r, j)

ordering whose spectators coincide with the canonical output ordering.

signature:

      ∑ i,
        ∑ j,

b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.lightMove_legal_of_domain_eq {m n : ℕ} (T : Finset (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
  (out inp : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.BlockPattern T ell) (pi sigma : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell)) (k : Fin ell)
  (hdom :
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.domainOfWord k (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord T ell out pi) =
      NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.domainOfWord k (NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord T ell inp sigma)) :
  have O := NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord T ell out pi;
  have I := NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord T ell inp sigma;
  ↑inp (I k) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.one ∧
    (O k = I k ∨ ↑inp (O k) = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Level.zero) ∧
      ↑out = NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.lightMove (↑inp) (I k) (O k)

doc:
A matching labelled spectator configuration is exactly a legal hard-core

combinatorial content of the bosonic compression.

Exact adjoint-grade transfer, including the normalized scalar.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.normalized_Lminus_gradeProjection_norm_le_envelope {d m n : ℕ}
  (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
  ‖(1 / ↑m) • NLAlib.SparseSketch.Lminus m F.rows * NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu‖ ≤
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.aTerm ↑d ↑nu ↑m + NLAlib.SparseSketch.bTerm ↑d ↑nu ↑m
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.normalized_Lminus_gradeProjection_norm_le_envelope
doc:
Assembly-shaped lowering estimate.  The two bottom grades vanish, while
all higher grades transfer exactly to the raising estimate two grades below.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.normalized_Lplus_gradeProjection_norm_le {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)
  (nu : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
  ‖(1 / ↑m) • NLAlib.SparseSketch.Lplus m F.rows * NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu‖ ≤
    √((↑d + ↑nu + 1) * (↑m + ↑nu)) / ↑m
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.normalized_Lplus_gradeProjection_norm_le
doc:
Exact normalized light raising estimate before its scalar envelope.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.normalized_Lplus_gradeProjection_norm_le_envelope {d m n : ℕ}
  (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
  ‖(1 / ↑m) • NLAlib.SparseSketch.Lplus m F.rows * NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu‖ ≤
    NLAlib.SparseSketch.aTerm ↑d ↑nu ↑m + NLAlib.SparseSketch.bTerm ↑d ↑nu ↑m
name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.normalized_Lplus_gradeProjection_norm_le_envelope
doc:
Assembly-shaped light raising estimate, with exactly the `aTerm+bTerm`

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.normalized_Lzero_gradeProjection_norm_le {d m n : ℕ} (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d)

doc:
Exact normalized grade-preserving light estimate before the assembly
envelope.

Source: ported from `SparseFockFormal.LightBandsConcrete`,
b9da2b5d96e5fd70252e9c6551aefc92643e7d0b; supports `sparse-ose`.

signature:
NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.normalized_Lzero_gradeProjection_norm_le_envelope {d m n : ℕ}
  (F : NLAlib.SparseSketch.Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
  ‖(1 / ↑m) • NLAlib.SparseSketch.Lzero m F.rows * NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection nu‖ ≤
    3 * NLAlib.SparseSketch.bTerm ↑d ↑nu ↑m
